newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC plans job cuts, new provision method.
newsitem.headline: SBC plans job cuts, new provision method.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp said it was making a "radical change" in its provisioning method and cutting some 1,700 domestic jobs while creating new structures in the bank's domestic division.
SBC said credit default is currently viewed as predictable risk that will occur with a degree of probability rather than as extraordinary and unexpected occurances as they were in the 1980s.

"Accordingly, statistically expected loan losses will in future be charged as an expense to the consolidated income statement," SBC said in statement. It also said a one-time reserve of 2.4 billion Swiss francs was being set up in the group's balance sheet to absorb volatility in actual annual individual provisioning requirements around the statistically expected mean.
SBC further stated that it was switching to a cash flow based approach to revalue its own real estate portfolio. This would result in an additional write-off of 910 million francs.
The measures, on top of an expected group profit of about 1.4 billion francs, will result in a one-time technical loss of about 1.9 billion francs, SBC also said.
